title: Building an idle RPG and I'd rather hear what's wrong with it now than after I call it finished
author: Guildbound
selftext:
Hey all. I've been working on Guildbound, an idle RPG that runs in the browser. Your hero walks to the rock and mines it instead of a bar filling up, and you can see other players working in the same zone.  
It's playable and people are playing it, but I don't want to be the dev who calls a game done and finds out later what everyone thought. So I'm asking now.  
What's in so far:  
Gear never drops. Players craft all of it and their name stays on it.  
You can commission another player to craft for you.  
Three factions, each with its own skills, so trading matters.  
The world just got some life: rocks throw chips, trees shake, fish swim (the gif).  
What I'd like to know:  
Where did you get bored or confused, and how many minutes in?  
What felt unfinished or rough?  
Is there anything you expected to be there that wasn't?  
Blunt is fine. A few things in the game already came from player suggestions, and I read everything.  
You can try it as a guest at [https://guildbound.online](https://guildbound.online), no sign-up needed. Thanks to anyone who gives it a few minutes.

We also have it on itch [https://m3ch4nism.itch.io/guildboundidle-rpg](https://m3ch4nism.itch.io/guildboundidle-rpg)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Guildbound please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.

comments.author: ArtificialBeingsInc
comments.body:
Tried the browser guest start with automated taps: melee + Ironbound, then the guide sent me to the chickens. The walk and automatic fight were easy to follow, and Leave queued until the wave finished.



I left it running while doing other work; after about five minutes it had reached wave 9. Back in Hearthvale I accepted Alda’s First Patrol and saw 0/8 chickens. I wasn’t expecting to go back for eight more after the first hunt. Could the guide offer the bounty before that hunt, or say upfront that earlier kills won’t count?



That’s just the opening; I haven’t tried crafting or the player market.

replies.author: Guildbound
replies.body: Omg thank you 😊 this is why I need more player feedback thank you! I’m on it!

replies.author: Guildbound
replies.body: Okay I just fixed it! Thank you for playing our discord has all patch notes, and settings offer our voting system
